verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack addresses telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out controls for GoDaddy's API, CLI, or MCP server; docs cover auth, rate limits, and domain/commerce features but nothing about disabling analytics or usage data collection. Missing for 10: any documentation of a telemetry opt-out setting, privacy/data-collection policy for the API/CLI/MCP, or user control over usage tracking.
